question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Strenuous
solution:
The correct answer is **'Formidable'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Strenuous is an adjective which means requiring or using great effort or exertion.
 
• The meaning of the given options are as follows - 
 
 
• Effective - successful in producing a desired or intended result.
 
• Amicable - characterized by friendliness and absence of discord.
 
• Formidable - inspiring fear or respect through being impressively large, powerful, intense, or capable.
 
• Manageable - able to be controlled or dealt with without difficulty.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is evident that formidable is the correct synonym for the word strenuous.
 
• Hence, **O**ption 3 is the correct answer.
